title: Student induction programme (UHV-I)
description: A guided introduction for every first-year student to self-exploration, relationships and life on campus.

title: Universal Human Values course (UHV-II)
description: A credit course in the curriculum that builds on the induction through discussion and reflection.

title: UHV faculty development programmes
description: Workshops that prepare faculty members to mentor students and facilitate UHV sessions.

title: Reflection circles
description: Small-group conversations led by faculty mentors through the academic year.

title: Values and technology talks
description: Sessions on fairness, privacy and responsibility in AI and engineering decisions.

title: Community outreach
description: Service activities with nearby schools and neighbourhoods that put values into practice.
